story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Jacob, and Ava. Jacob asserted: "Ava is an angel and Ava is a devil". Ava commented, "Jacob is a devil or Ava is an angel". So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Jacob is a angel/devil, and Ava is a angel/devil")

Jacob is an angel, Ava is a devil
Jacob is a devil, Ava is an angel
Jacob is a devil, Ava is a devil
